text:
The Mega Crocodile vs The Wild Carnivorous Flower Pit 

Seedance 2 prompt. 

Nightmare creature island. Dense prehistoric jungle. Giant ferns, twisted roots, thick humidity, insects screaming in the background. Sunlight barely reaches the ground. Hyper-real creature-feature action. Chaotic handheld cinematography, aggressive speed ramps, crash zooms, whip pans, low-angle tracking shots. Sound: crocodile roars, breaking trees, snapping plant jaws, frantic breathing.

⸻

0–2s — HOOK

Low-angle handheld tracking shot.

A survivor is already sprinting through dense jungle.

Branches whip across frame.

Behind him—

A gigantic mega crocodile explodes through the vegetation.

Forty feet long.

Ancient scars covering its body.

Trees snap in half as it charges.

Its jaws slam shut inches behind him.

⸻

2–5s — ESCALATION

Side tracking shot.

The survivor jumps over roots and fallen logs.

The crocodile ignores obstacles completely.

It bulldozes through everything.

Entire bushes and small trees are launched into the air.

The gap between them shrinks rapidly.

The survivor looks ahead—

A strange clearing.

⸻

5–8s — FALSE SAFETY

Wide shot.

The survivor bursts into a beautiful field of enormous flowers.

Bright colors.

Huge petals.

Completely peaceful.

He doesn’t stop.

Runs straight through.

The crocodile follows at full speed.

Then—

The ground beneath the crocodile cracks.

⸻

8–11s — REVEAL

Crash zoom downward.

The entire flower field collapses.

Hidden beneath it—

A gigantic biological pit.

Hundreds of flower stalks erupt upward.

But these aren’t flowers.

Each bloom opens into a circular mouth lined with jagged teeth.

The crocodile falls directly into the center.

⸻

11–13s — CHAOS

The flower creatures attack immediately.

Dozens latch onto the crocodile.

The beast thrashes violently.

Flower heads are ripped apart.

Others immediately replace them.

The entire pit becomes a feeding frenzy.

Petals.

Teeth.

Mud.

Blood-red pollen exploding everywhere.

⸻

13–15s — SHOCKING PAYOFF

The ground shakes.

A colossal flower rises from the center of the pit.

Its bloom is larger than a truck.

It wraps around the struggling crocodile.

Then violently launches it into the air.

The giant flower opens fully—

Catches the airborne crocodile whole—

And swallows it in a single motion.

The survivor stares in disbelief.

Then the giant flower slowly turns toward him.

Its mouth begins opening again.

Hard cut to black.
content: Nightmare creature island. Dense prehistoric jungle. Giant ferns, twisted roots, thick humidity, insects screaming in the background. Sunlight barely reaches the ground. Hyper-real creature-feature action. Chaotic handheld cinematography, aggressive speed ramps, crash zooms, whip pans, low-angle tracking shots. Sound: crocodile roars, breaking trees, snapping plant jaws, frantic breathing.

translations.es: Isla de criaturas de pesadilla. Jungla prehistórica densa. Helechos gigantes, raíces retorcidas, humedad espesa, insectos chillando de fondo. La luz del sol apenas alcanza el suelo. Acción de criaturas hiperrealista. Cinematografía caótica con cámara en mano, rampas de velocidad agresivas, zooms repentinos, whip pans, tomas de seguimiento en ángulo bajo. Sonido: rugidos de cocodrilo, árboles rompiéndose, mandíbulas de plantas chasqueando, respiración frenética.
translations.fr:
---
Île des créatures cauchemardesques. Jungle préhistorique dense. Fougères géantes, racines tordues, humidité épaisse, insectes criant en arrière-plan. La lumière du soleil atteint à peine le sol. Action hyper-réaliste de créatures. Cinématographie chaotique à la main, accélérations agressives, zooms rapides, panoramiques fouettés, plans de suivi en contre-plongée. Son : rugissements de crocodiles, arbres qui se brisent, mâchoires de plantes qui claquent, respiration frénétique.
---
translations.ja:
---
ナイトメアクリーチャーアイランド。密集した先史時代のジャングル。巨大なシダ、ねじれた根、厚い湿気、背景で叫ぶ昆虫。日光はほとんど地面に届かない。ハイパーリアルなクリーチャーフィーチャーアクション。混沌としたハンドヘルド撮影、アグレッシブなスピードランプ、クラッシュズーム、ウィップパン、低角度のトラッキングショット。音響：ワニの咆哮、折れる木々、噛みつく植物の顎、慌ただしい呼吸。
translations.ko:
---
악몽의 생물 섬. 울창한 선사 시대 정글. 거대한 양치식물, 뒤틀린 뿌리, 짙은 습기, 배경에서 울부짖는 곤충들. 햇빛이 거의 땅에 닿지 않는다. 하이퍼 리얼 생물 액션. 혼란스러운 핸드헬드 시네마토그래피, 공격적인 스피드 램프, 크래시 줌, 휩 팬, 로우 앵글 트래킹 샷. 소리: 악어의 포효, 부러지는 나무, 부러지는 식물의 턱, 다급한 숨소리.
translations.pt-BR: Ilha de criaturas de pesadelo. Selva pré-histórica densa. Samambaias gigantes, raízes retorcidas, umidade espessa, insetos gritando ao fundo. A luz do sol mal chega ao chão. Ação hiper-realista de criaturas. Cinematografia caótica de câmera na mão, rampas de velocidade agressivas, zooms rápidos, whip pans, tomadas de rastreamento em ângulo baixo. Som: rugidos de crocodilo, árvores quebrando, mandíbulas de plantas estalando, respiração frenética.
translations.zh-CN:
---
梦魇生物岛。浓密的史前丛林。巨大的蕨类植物，扭曲的树根，厚重的湿气，背景中昆虫的尖叫声。阳光几乎无法到达地面。超现实的生物特写动作。混乱的手持摄影，激进的速度变化，快速变焦，快速横移，低角度跟踪镜头。声音：鳄鱼的咆哮，断裂的树木，植物颚的咔嚓声，急促的呼吸。
